name: sirius-ai
description: Sirius's own chat for VS Code: your models — Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI and nine more, or your own local server — with their thinking shown as it streams; Tab completion from a code model on your machine; commit messages.

enumDescriptions: Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line.
Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) sends; Enter starts a new line.
sirius.panel.sendWith.description: How a message is sent from Sirius's message box.

sirius.completions.enable.markdownDescription: Tab completion, per language: `"*"` for every language, and a language id such as `"markdown"` for that one alone. It needs a code model on your own Ollama or llama.cpp server, at the address in Sirius's **Models and Keys**; see `#sirius.completions.model#`.

sirius.completions.model.markdownDescription: The model Tab completion fills in with: `auto` takes a code model on Ollama, else llama.cpp; `ollama/<model>` one Ollama model; `llamacpp` the llama.cpp server. Their addresses are in Sirius's **Models and Keys**.

sirius.completions.maxLines.description: The longest suggestion Tab completion offers, in lines.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Sirius
walkthroughs.description: Your own models in Sirius's chat, with their thinking shown as it streams.

steps.title: Open Sirius
steps.description:
Sirius lives in the secondary side bar, on the right of the window. Open it here, or with **Sirius: Open Sirius** in the Command Palette.
[Open Sirius](command:sirius.open)

steps.title: Add a model
steps.description:
In **Models and Keys**, add Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI or another provider with your own key. It goes into your system keyring, never into your settings or the chat's page. Ollama, LM Studio and llama.cpp on their usual ports are found without adding anything.
[Open Models and Keys](command:sirius.panel.setup)

steps.title: Ask, Edit or Agent
steps.description:
Under the message box, pick a mode, a model and how hard it thinks. **Ask** answers questions about your code, **Edit** changes your files, **Agent** works through a task step by step. Each change opens as a diff to accept or reject — or, with **Auto-accept edits**, applies as it comes. Enter sends; to send with Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) instead, change **Sirius › Panel: Send With**.
[Open Sirius](command:sirius.open)
[Send With](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22sirius.panel.sendWith%22)

steps.title: Code as you type
steps.description:
Tab completion fills in code at the cursor from a code model on your own machine — Ollama with a coder model, or llama-server. It is off until you turn it on.
[Turn On Tab Completion](command:sirius.completions.turnOn)

steps.title: Write commit messages
steps.description:
In Source Control, **Write Commit Message** (the sparkle at the top) writes the message for your changes with the model chosen in Sirius.
[Open Source Control](command:workbench.view.scm)

steps.title: Keep your conversations
steps.description:
Every conversation is kept for this workspace and comes back after a reload. Open an earlier one from **Conversations**, or give Sirius a tab of its own.
[Open in New Tab](command:sirius.panel.openInTab)
